claims.text: The resort sits on the 660-acre PGA Frisco campus, which also includes Fields Ranch, The PGA District, PGA of America and Northern Texas PGA.

findings.quote: The 660-acre campus is a unique destination that includes Fields Ranch, Omni PGA Frisco Resort & Spa, The PGA District, PGA of America, and Northern Texas PGA.

claims.text: PGA Frisco is a public/private partnership between the PGA of America, Omni Hotels & Resorts, the City of Frisco and the Frisco Independent School District.

findings.quote: PGA Frisco is a public/private partnership between the PGA of America, Omni Hotels & Resorts, the City of Frisco and the Frisco Independent School District.

claims.text: Omni PGA Frisco Resort & Spa features two championship golf courses, a full-service spa and four pools.

findings.quote: Omni PGA Frisco Resort & Spa features 2 championship golf courses, full-service spa, 4 pools & 13 restaurants & bars.

claims.text: Fields Ranch West is a Beau Welling-designed course encouraging shotmaking and creativity.

findings.quote: A Beau Welling-designed course encouraging shotmaking and creativity.

claims.text: The Swing is a lighted 10-hole, par-3 short course for golfers of all skill levels.

findings.quote: Lighted 10-hole, par-3 short course is for golfers of all skill levels.

claims.text: PGA Frisco is the home of the 2027 PGA Championship.
The Ranch House Villas have chef kitchens, outdoor patios with fire pits and interiors filled with natural light.

findings.quote: Enjoy chef kitchens, outdoor patios with fire pits, 4.5 bathrooms and expansive interiors filled with natural light.

claims.text: The Leisure Pool Bar sits next to two pools and a splash pad.

findings.quote: vibrant pool mixology to elevate your day next to two pools and a splash pad.

claims.text: Ice House is a ranch-style venue with BBQ from the pit and six live hitting bays.

findings.quote: A ranch-style venue serving cold beer and cocktails along with hearty BBQ from the pit for hungry golfers. Features six live hitting bays and stunning fairway views.

claims.text: Trick Rider is a Texas-style supper club specializing in steaks and seafood.

findings.quote: A Texas-style supper club paying homage to traditions with a modern twist, specializing in signature steaks and seafood dishes.

claims.text: The Collective Green shop in the resort lobby carries brands such as Peter Millar, Greyson, Vuori and Holderness & Bourne.

findings.quote: Located in the lobby of the resort, featuring styles from top brands like Peter Millar, Greyson, Vuori, and Holderness & Bourne.

claims.text: Fields Ranch East is a Gil Hanse-designed course offering a strategic challenge.

findings.quote: A Gil Hanse-designed course offering a compelling strategic challenge.

claims.text: The Dance Floor is a lighted two-acre putting course co-designed by Gil Hanse and Beau Welling.

findings.quote: Lighted 2-acre putting course co-designed by Gil Hanse and Beau Welling.

claims.text: The Ranch House Villas are four-bedroom villas designed as a modern take on the Texas ranch home.

findings.quote: A modern take on the Texas ranch home, 10 spacious four-bedroom villas are perfect for a golf or family getaway.

claims.text: Mokara Spa includes a sauna, a steam room and a private pool for spa guests.

findings.quote: this rejuvenating spa includes 20 private treatment rooms, a sauna, steam room, a private pool for spa guests, and a relaxing café.

claims.text: Trick Rider's horseshoe-shaped bar sits under Cinnamon, a Swarovski crystal horse chandelier.

findings.quote: Enjoy a cocktail at the horseshoe-shaped bar, under the glimmer of Cinnamon, a Swarovski crystal horse chandelier.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the resort is in suburban Frisco, so Dallas attractions require transportation.
